title: oggolimteh tan roocih safar
intro: Ayyuntiinô qaadoodi lowsis gubat gacte waktil, baxsale numtin amoh abak raag kaxxa milaagih barkat le buxah marih addat geytima. Ken aydaadi, kacni angaaraw kee yallih amri, dumaahi qaadoodi diggalsimaanam kee qusba, gitah tan radmooma xissimtam baxxaqissa. Ta xaagi nummah tuxxiiqih kobox kee Yallih amritteh derret tan wale taybulle.
clues: Anu inki adda axawat suge, takkay immay qibaadah massos, Anu qusba buxa kee buxah mara gee.
Anu kaxxam kiciyyoh sugeeh, inni buxah mara kee inni xayloh fanat doorit yoh yecee waqdi, anu wadirsi mara luk raaqam doorite.
Yi migaq inki adda yi ayyuntih addal yamixxigeh yan abtoota lih angaaraw luk suge.
Anu dubuh yan wakliita kinniyo ellecaboh farmoyti migaq kaak qaduk galab kak xagem Yalli Qur'aanak.
Anu nabiyyi qammih baxak sugte massakaxxale barrat digibe, takkay immay ni digib sarrimaane luk masuginna.
Yi cabtik lakal, Yalli isih yok dumaahi barra Nabiyyih digibih amriseeh, tohih taagah adoption wagittaamal dumaahi qaada bayseh.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: yi digib kee cabti wagittaamal yallih amri
trial.answer: yi digib kee cabti wagittaamal yallih amri

outcome.answer: Islaaminnaak dumal sugteh tan abtoota baysaanam 'xayyowte xaylo xayloh xaylo axcuk seecaanama'

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
